summary: Verified Shop-by-Category follow-ups: (1) no <a>-in-<a> warnings, (2) all category-card images load on /skincare and /cosmetics, (3) admin Sections/Visibility tab exposes new toggle + 3-input config block for both niches, (4) toggle off + save hides the section on the niche home, toggle on + custom eyebrow round-trips correctly, (5) AI Auto-fill button on the Create New Product flow works (200 from /api/admin/ai/generate-product-content and tagline/description/key_ingredients/size React state populated). Backend regression 17/17 still passes.
action_items: (Minor / test-coverage only) Create-flow inputs at AdminProducts.js lines ~1039/1041/key-ingredients/packaging-size have no data-testid. Add data-testid='new-tagline', 'new-description', 'new-key-ingredients', 'new-size' so future automated tests can assert AI-fill results without screenshot inspection.

(Minor) /api/site-settings returns null for category_showcase_subtitle / category_showcase_highlight when the admin hasn't explicitly edited them. The CategoryShowcase component falls back to defaults (works fine), but consider seeding these in the default niche_settings payload for clarity in admin UI.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/productImage.js cleanly normalises legacy '/api/uploads/...' relative paths and Cloudinary absolute URLs — good single-source-of-truth helper, used consistently across SearchBar, ConcernCategoryPage, AdminProducts and CategoryShowcase.
CategoryShowcase outer card is now role='link' div with keyboard handler — no more <a>-in-<a> nesting and inner ProductChip <button>s stop event propagation correctly.

AdminNiches Save round-trips through PUT /api/admin/site-settings persisting show_category_showcase / category_showcase_title|subtitle|highlight under niche_settings.<niche>; verified persisted values via GET /api/site-settings.

AI Auto-fill (ai-fill-from-name) handler in AdminProducts.js correctly merges AI response into editProduct state (tagline/description/key_ingredients/packaging_size). API returned 200 in <5s for prompt 'Vitamin C Brightening Serum'.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled skincare show_category_showcase off then back ON during the test and restored eyebrow to 'Shop by Category' default — final state matches pre-test state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Shop-by-Category + AI auto-fill follow-ups validated end-to-end. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ passes 17/17 (run with: cd /app/backend && set -a && . /app/frontend/.env && . /app/backend/.env && set +a && python -m pytest tests/ -v). For UI: vis-category-showcase-{skincare,cosmetics} is a button toggle (text 'shown'/'hidden', not aria-checked) — to flip programmatically, click and read innerText. The 3 config inputs use testids category-showcase-{title,subtitle,highlight}-{niche}. Save button is [data-testid='save-niches']. Skincare home + Cosmetics home re-render using niche_settings on each load (no client cache).
verified_behaviors: /skincare loads with [data-testid='skincare-category-showcase'] + 7 cards; 10/10 product images successfully loaded (img.complete && naturalWidth>0); zero validateDOMNesting warnings in console.
/cosmetics loads with [data-testid='cosmetics-category-showcase'] + 5 cards; 12/12 images loaded; zero nesting warnings.

Admin /admin/niches → Skincare → Sections/Visibility shows [data-testid='vis-category-showcase-skincare'] toggle + [data-testid='category-showcase-config-skincare'] block with 3 inputs (testids: category-showcase-title-skincare, category-showcase-subtitle-skincare, category-showcase-highlight-skincare).
Same set present for cosmetics (vis-category-showcase-cosmetics + category-showcase-config-cosmetics).

Toggling vis-category-showcase-skincare from 'shown' to 'hidden' + clicking save-niches persists show_category_showcase=false to /api/site-settings; reloading /skincare no longer renders the showcase section.
Toggling back ON + setting eyebrow text persists; reloading /skincare renders the showcase with the updated eyebrow text (uppercased visually).

Admin /admin/products → Add new product → [data-testid='ai-fill-from-name'] button rendered next to [data-testid='new-name']; clicking after typing 'Vitamin C Brightening Serum' calls POST /api/admin/ai/generate-product-content which returns 200 in <5s; tagline/description/key-ingredient chips/packaging size all auto-populated.
